desc: The Crew Dual Tactical Pistol Case features an all-weather, durable 600D polyester storage solution, designed for two handguns, with very functional and convenient features. This ideal sidearm case helps you transport two pistols, enough mags, and additional shooting accessories with spacious pockets and organization. Pistol compartments are lockable for additional security while the laser cut MOLLE system enables you to attach and customize for the accessories you need most.
